County Board Openings - Application Form
Ward County Library Board – Two Openings
The Ward County Board of Commissioners is accepting applications for two open positions on the Ward County Library Board. The Library Board oversees matters related to the Ward County Public Library and meets at 1:30 p.m. on the second Tuesday of each month. Board members serve three-year terms. These two positions are for terms that began July 1, 2026. Application Deadline: Friday, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Applicants are expected to be interviewed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners at its December 1, 2026 meeting. Interested individuals should complete the Board or Commission Application and submit it to the Ward County Auditor/Treasurer’s Office.
City of Minot Planning Commission – Two Openings
The Ward County Board of Commissioners is accepting applications for two Ward County representative positions on the City of Minot Planning Commission. One opening is for an unexpired term ending December 31, 2028. The second is for a five-year term beginning January 1, 2027. Ward County representatives must reside outside the City of Minot but within the City's two-mile extraterritorial jurisdiction. Application Deadline: Friday, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Applicants are expected to be interviewed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners at its December 1, 2026 meeting. Interested individuals should complete the Board or Commission Application and submit it to the Ward County Auditor/Treasurer’s Office.
All Seasons Arena Board – One Opening
The Ward County Board of Commissioners is accepting applications for one At-Large position on the All Seasons Arena Board. The At-Large member is appointed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners. The position is a one-year term beginning January 2, 2027. Application Deadline: Friday, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Applicants are expected to be interviewed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners at its December 1, 2026 meeting. Interested individuals should complete the Board or Commission Application and submit it to the Ward County Auditor/Treasurer’s Office.
Ward County Human Service Zone Board – Two Openings
The Ward County Board of Commissioners is accepting applications for two positions on the Ward County Human Service Zone Board. The Human Service Zone Board provides oversight of the Ward County Human Service Zone. The two positions are three-year terms beginning January 1, 2027. Application Deadline: Friday, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Applicants are expected to be interviewed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners at its December 1, 2026 meeting. Interested individuals should complete the Board or Commission Application and submit it to the Ward County Auditor/Treasurer’s Office.
Ward County Water Resource Board – One Opening
The Ward County Board of Commissioners is accepting applications for one position on the Ward County Water Resource Board. The Water Resource Board addresses water-management matters within its jurisdiction, including drainage, flood control, water-related projects, and permit matters. The position is a three-year term beginning January 1, 2027. Application Deadline: Friday, November 20, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. Applicants are expected to be interviewed by the Ward County Board of Commissioners at its December 1, 2026 meeting. Interested individuals should complete the Board or Commission Application and submit it to the Ward County Auditor/Treasurer’s Office.
For questions on board or commission openings please call the Auditor's Office at 857-6420
